resource_assessment.disk_limitations: 897243540 declared expanded bytes for four package wheels alone, before NumPy/Pandas/PDFium/Shapely/python-bidi/other transitives, interpreter, model files, bytecode, pip/build cache and Docker layers. About1.9GiB local free is not proof a clean image build fits. Remote directory data is metadata, not installed footprint or content validation; no deployed ephemeral-storage limit is declared in the inventory.
resource_assessment.ram_and_latency: No authoritative measured minimum/peak for this exact Arabic mobile pair at one CPU/768MiB found. Model weight size is not RSS. Official Arabic time cells are blank; general timings use Xeon6271C and8threads, with pre/postprocessing excluded. Import/init/peak/steady-state/cgroup file-cache and Node-parent coexistence remain unmeasured.
resource_assessment.model_download_policy: Only official small source/metadata and bounded wheel ZIP directory ranges read. No full wheels, model weights, installs, builds, recognition calls or production calls.

reading_order_assessment.line_support: Official Arabic dictionary contains Arabic, Latin letters, punctuation, Western and Arabic-Indic digits. Runner applies python-bidi.get_display to line text. This is explicit RTL handling, not verified logical Unicode correctness for dates, IDs, brackets or mixed scripts.
reading_order_assessment.page_support: General pipeline SortQuadBoxes sorts y then ascending x. Two RTL columns or split Arabic fragments on the same baseline can be returned in the wrong semantic order. No page-language-aware logical order guarantee is present.
reading_order_assessment.required_oracle: Compare the exact normalized logical Unicode sequence and block order against pre-output gold, not rendered appearance. Retain original upstream returned rec_texts, polygons and scores. Those returned strings have already passed through the upstream bidi display transformation; they must not be called raw pre-bidi network output or assumed logical text. No blind reversal, opportunity-language inference or gold-specific reorder fix.
reading_order_assessment.limit: Standard upright single-column pages can be an initial candidate scope, but two-column/split-line controls must remain in the qualification set and report failures, not disappear as unsupported successes.

fixed_candidate_settings.models: Exact pinned mobile detector plus Arabic v5 model, explicit local directories
fixed_candidate_settings.engine: paddle_static CPU; one CPU inference thread; batch1 page and crop; no automatic downloads
fixed_candidate_settings.preprocessing: Existing <=2000px whole-page raster unchanged; one frozen official mobile detector resize policy, no post-output pixel/threshold search
fixed_candidate_settings.extra_models: Document orientation, unwarp and textline orientation disabled explicitly for predeclared upright typed-page candidate scope; no claim about rotated/warped sources
fixed_candidate_settings.recognition_filter: Explicit score_thresh0.0; all detected line results retained, no confidence-based omission or correctness assertion
fixed_candidate_settings.ordering: Preserve the unmodified upstream returned text and polygon order. This is post-bidi display transformation, not a demonstrated logical Unicode stream. Compare it to logical gold and retain any mismatch; no application ordering patch in this first run.

smallest_proposed_experiment.run_sequence: Once the root agent allocates a serialized native-test window and disk/dependency preflight succeeds, measure one offline cold initialization plus blank page under the existing 768 MiB/1 CPU/no-swap/90-second envelope. A resource failure stops the experiment and is retained. If it passes, process all 13 frozen pages sequentially with per-page 90 seconds and a fixed campaign cap, retaining failed and not-run denominators. Include the actual parent wrapper overhead in the same cgroup. No ensemble, second candidate or parameter search. This is execution coordination within the existing user-authorized testing scope, not a new user-permission requirement.
smallest_proposed_experiment.acceptance: All new and old critical obligations, negation, dates, quantities, IDs and logical block order must survive; full normalized-page oracle unchanged in substance. Report complete page matches plus every critical omission/substitution/order defect, OOM/timeout/peak memory/process cleanup. Passing this finite synthetic set permits only further qualification, never universal correctness or removal of mandatory page review.
smallest_proposed_experiment.stop_or_remaining: If memory/disk fails, do not silently raise resources or substitute conversion engines. If reading order or text fails, preserve raw evidence and maintain reviewed page correction as the current supported recovery. Future adoption needs versioned engine/provenance contract (current UploadedOcrPage engine is tesseract), current source binding and all existing review/authorization guards.
smallest_proposed_experiment.gold_normalization: Freeze normalization before any recognizer output: NFC Unicode, normalized line endings and explicitly specified whitespace handling only. Do not silently reverse Arabic, reorder blocks, fold punctuation/digits, strip negation or repair from expected text. Exact-page mismatch and critical semantic defect are reported separately.
